# Fold Fleet: Sea Strike

Fold Fleet: Sea Strike is a free naval strategy game for iPhone with offline computer battles, online Game Center matches, and Real 3D ocean or classic Legacy grid modes.

## Key facts
- Free to download and play on iPhone with iOS 17 or later.
- Play vs Computer works offline; online matches use Apple Game Center.
- Real mode is a boardless 3D ocean with missiles, airstrikes, torpedoes, and sonar; Legacy mode uses a classic grid and pegs.
- Special layouts support foldable iPhone tabletop, book, and flat positions.
- No personal data is collected by the app; progress stays on-device, with no ads or tracking. Apple provides Game Center and StoreKit.
